title: Listening Drill — Plaster cast display — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Plaster cast display — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on plaster cast display last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with hairline cracks. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: damaged support.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of cast surface so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow soft cloth instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the gallery technician before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Saturday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
